tagline.en: NVIDIA GR00T — a vision-language-action foundation model for generalist humanoid and robot policies.
tagline.zh: NVIDIA GR00T——面向通用人形机器人与机器人策略的视觉-语言-动作基础模型。

en: GR00T is NVIDIA's vision-language-action (VLA) foundation model for robots, from the Isaac GR00T project. It takes camera views, robot state, and a language instruction, and outputs the actions a humanoid or generalist robot should take.

WorldFoundry integrates the N1 line, including a 2B model and an N1.7 checkpoint fine-tuned on the LIBERO benchmark, with a Cosmos-Reason2-2B backbone as its vision-language component. It runs from a flattened in-tree package with checkpoint-hosted Python disabled, so only trusted local code executes.

In WorldFoundry you run GR00T as a policy — feed it observations and an instruction, and it produces action rollouts. The staged assets carry only the runtime subset needed, and inference performs no download.
zh: GR00T 是 NVIDIA 面向机器人的视觉-语言-动作(VLA)基础模型,出自 Isaac GR00T 项目。它接收相机视图、机器人状态与一条语言指令,输出人形或通用机器人应执行的动作。
WorldFoundry 接入了 N1 系列,包括一个 2B 模型和在 LIBERO 基准上微调的 N1.7 checkpoint,以 Cosmos-Reason2-2B 作为其视觉-语言骨干。它从扁平化的内置包运行,并禁用 checkpoint 内托管的 Python,因此只执行受信任的本地代码。
在 WorldFoundry 中,你把 GR00T 作为策略运行——给它观测与指令,它便产出动作 rollout。就位的资产只含所需的运行时子集,推理过程不进行下载。

whenToUse.en: Use GR00T when you want a vision-language-action policy for humanoid or generalist robot control, driving actions from camera observations and a language instruction.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想要一个用于人形或通用机器人控制的视觉-语言-动作策略,从相机观测与语言指令驱动动作时,适合使用 GR00T。

notFor.en: It's a robot policy model, not a video or image generator. Simulator or hardware rollout brings its own setup, and checkpoints must be staged locally beforehand.
notFor.zh: 它是机器人策略模型,而非视频或图像生成器。仿真或硬件 rollout 需另行配置,且 checkpoint 需事先在本地就位。
